This EXCLUDES all 3 of the just-admitted candidate-state procedures (verification_state='candidate', not 'verified') from being found under production-default settings. Given this session's own earlier corpus characterization (~1038 total procedures, ~7 'verified' and all of those confirmed synthetic/demo content, not real externally-ingested knowledge), running arm B under the DEFAULT config on a real, novel SWE task will almost certainly retrieve NOTHING relevant and silently fall through to the SAME ad-hoc path arm A takes -- making a null result the honest EXPECTED outcome under default settings, not evidence Stealth 'doesn't work'. See hypotheses.md.
